bullets.id: Emas berayun sekitar $60 dalam sehari. Kitco mencatat spot sempat turun ke sekitar $3.994,60 (minus 0,54%) di sesi pagi AS, lalu ditutup di $4.058,20 (naik 1,05%) seiring reli Wall Street. Rabu pagi, Trading Economics menunjukkan emas sekitar $4.050 (turun 0,24%) setelah dua sesi naik. Dalam sebulan emas masih turun 3,14%, sekitar 27,8% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 pada Januari 2026.
bullets.en: Gold swung about $60 in a day. Kitco had spot dipping to about $3,994.60 (down 0.54%) in the US morning, then closing at $4,058.20 (up 1.05%) as Wall Street rallied. On Wednesday morning, Trading Economics shows gold near $4,050 (down 0.24%) after two sessions of gains. Gold is still down 3.14% on the month, about 27.8% below its $5,608.35 record from January 2026.

bullets.id: Data AS cukup kuat: pesanan barang tahan lama September naik 1,8% dan keyakinan konsumen Oktober melonjak ke 91,7 dari 84,2. Yield Treasury 10 tahun sekitar 4,99%, indeks dolar sekitar 102,23, Brent dekat $114 dan WTI dekat $100. Fed funds futures memberi peluang sekitar 90,6% Fed menahan suku bunga di 3,75–4,00%, tetapi peluang kenaikan lagi sebelum akhir tahun sekitar 73%.
bullets.en: US data was fairly strong: September durable goods orders rose 1.8% and October consumer confidence jumped to 91.7 from 84.2. The 10-year Treasury yield is about 4.99%, the dollar index about 102.23, Brent near $114 and WTI near $100. Fed funds futures give about 90.6% odds that the Fed holds at 3.75–4.00%, but about 73% odds of another hike by year-end.

bullets.id: Agenda: keputusan Fed Kamis 01.00 WIB dan konferensi pers Ketua Fed Kevin Warsh 01.30 WIB, lalu PDB kuartal III, PCE September dan klaim pengangguran Kamis 19.30 WIB. Kitco mencatat resistance $4.079 dan $4.100 (target $4.160–4.180) serta support $4.039 dan $4.015 (target $3.975 lalu $3.959).
bullets.en: Agenda: the Fed decision at 01:00 WIB Thursday and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s press conference at 01:30 WIB, then Q3 GDP, September PCE and jobless claims on Thursday at 19:30 WIB. Kitco puts resistance at $4,079 and $4,100 (targets $4,160–4,180) and support at $4,039 and $4,015 (targets $3,975, then $3,959).

bullets.id: Harga Antam 1 gram naik Rp20.000 ke Rp2.570.000, kenaikan kedua berturut-turut. Buyback naik Rp20.000 ke Rp2.365.000 (spread Rp205.000, sekitar 8,0%). Galeri24 naik Rp11.000 ke Rp2.478.000 (buyback Rp2.336.000, spread sekitar 5,7%) dan UBS naik Rp10.000 ke Rp2.501.000 (buyback Rp2.311.000, spread sekitar 7,6%), jadi selisih Antam dengan Galeri24 melebar ke Rp92.000.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price rose Rp20,000 to Rp2,570,000, its second straight rise. Buyback rose Rp20,000 to Rp2,365,000 (a Rp205,000 spread, about 8.0%). Galeri24 rose Rp11,000 to Rp2,478,000 (buyback Rp2,336,000, spread about 5.7%) and UBS rose Rp10,000 to Rp2,501,000 (buyback Rp2,311,000, spread about 7.6%), so Antam’s gap over Galeri24 widens to Rp92,000.
